name: Tun Mai Ulat Bulu
bio: Once Ahmad appoints him, Tun Mai is a route from court to watch and quay. Orders brought by his men are not survivals of Hasan’s household arrangements.
notes: fact: Brown records his appointment by Ahmad, his injury in the defense and his later death in exile (Brown chs. XXII–XXIII, pp. 166–169; ch. XXVIII, p. 192)
gameplay: His particular quay assignments are invented; the portfolio does not make him the earlier incumbent (people-factions.md §2)
